notes: «قال فقال عمر بن الخطاب أولا تبعثون» is Umar's proposal inside the story, not the saying: the saying is the Prophet's command, so the chain ends at Ibn Umar (rule 6). The compiler's grade («قال أبو عيسى ... حسن صحيح») is left out.
